ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low high-intensity to low-intensity ratio; surface is predominantly comprised of low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels with less than 3% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple white linear rake marks on the right lobe and focal scarring/barnacles along the peripheral edges.
